entries.name: 市井朱红
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied existing transparent game entry icon. The existing image is the EDIT TARGET, not a sheet to reproduce. Keep its attractive open-book silhouette, perspective, thick ivory pages, dimensional rendering, theme materials, binding, corner details and polished Chinese casual-game illustration style. Make ONLY these requested changes:
1. Completely REMOVE BOTH the old shrimp and the old whole shiitake mushroom. Replace them with TWO LUXURY HOTPOT-READY INGREDIENTS, with NO SHELLS: LEFT page has three elegant rolled slices of snowflake-marbled WAGYU BEEF, vivid ruby-red meat with beautiful fine creamy white marbling and appetizing curled cross-sections; RIGHT page has a small elegant fan of three long thin MATSUTAKE MUSHROOM SLICES, creamy white flesh, lightly toasted tan cap edges and visible slender stem shape. They should clearly look like ingredients ready to put into a Chinese hotpot. Render as substantial illustrated food relief on the book pages, not as printed photos. Keep the ingredients separated by the book crease, large simple readable silhouettes at small icon size. No crustaceans, no crab, no lobster, no shrimp, no seafood shells, no whole shellfish, no bone, no ordinary round shiitake cap, no plateful of cooked dishes.
2. Add a beautiful integrated CLICKABLE BUTTON PLAQUE across the LOWER FRONT of the book, below the food, with a tactile rounded/beveled rim and soft short shadow. Its EXACT text is the two Simplified Chinese characters "图鉴". Correct Chinese strokes; 图 first, 鉴 second. Both characters bold, large, upright, centered and high-contrast. This plaque should be about 42% of icon width, easily recognized as the collection entry when shrunk to a small mobile game button. Do not obscure either food illustration. No other words, no ingredient labels, no extra symbols that look like text.
Square canvas, exactly ONE complete finished icon, generous transparent margins around all corners and bookmark. Preserve a genuinely transparent alpha background. No scenery, no UI screenshot, no flat app tile surrounding the book, no outer caption, no watermark. This is design-only artwork, not code.
Preserve vermilion lacquer cover, antique warm golden cloud corner guards and emerald bookmark. New plaque: deep emerald lacquer with fine antique gold rim and large embossed warm gold 图鉴 lettering. Premium festive Chinese restaurant craft.
